Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted that the earliest commercial release of Icehouse pieces was 1999 without citing evidence, conflating the first boxed set (Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set) with the initial release of the pieces. This ignored available indications that pieces were being manufactured by 1989 and originated in 1987, which would place Icehouse pieces before Kill Doctor Lucky (1996), leading toward the wrong conclusion.
